notes.title: Tinting Time is finally here! Enjoy crafting concoctions and making new friends！
notes.content:
Greetings, everyone!

This is Mr. Bambam, the creator of Tinting Time, with some exciting news! The long-awaited release date for Tinting Time has finally arrived!

I am thrilled to share that every aspect of this game was created solely by me. From game design, coding, avatars, icons, cutscenes, and dialogs, down to the music and sound effects, every detail was crafted with care to bring you a unique and enjoyable gaming experience.

While Tinting Time draws inspiration from tile-matching games, I have added a resource management system that sets it apart from similar games. It may seem challenging at first, but I hope you will have fun playing it.

I am grateful for all the support and positive feedback I have received during the development of Tinting Time. If you have any feedback or suggestions for the game, please share them with us on our Steam Community or leave a message here.

Enjoy Tinting Time!

Best regards,
Mr. BamBam

notes.title: "Tinting Time" Officially Launching on August 15th
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I am Mr. BamBam, the creator of "Tinting Time".

We're excited to announce that "Tinting Time" is set for its official release on August 15th(Beijing time). During the game's launch period, we're offering an exclusive 10% discount. We hope to provide all of you with a fantastic gaming experience.

If you have any questions, please leave me a message.

notes.title: Demo 0.7.2 Update
notes.content:
This update has improved the quality of life and fixed some bugs

Looking forward to the release of the game

[list]
[*]The game title has become more high-definition
[*]The initial scene of the game has been remaked
[*]Add the function of skipping conversations with the ctrl key
[*]Buttons will be displayed in the interact prompt
[*]Optimization of quest delivery page
[*]The display of the door is more obvious
[*]Larger font for tutorial guidance
[*]Dialogue options can be selected through the keyboard
[*]The NPC of the plot task will display the avatar on the map
[*]When viewing a solution from bookmark, clicking Close can directly close the encyclopedia instead of returning to the upper menu
[*]Increase the maximum basic focus (100 → 150)
[*]Avril facility quest can increase in the limit of focus (10 → 25)
[*]Bug fix: Stuck after close the load menu in the Nuby story
[*]Bug fix: Some properties in the solution property map are not displayed
[/list]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Live Streaming #2
notes.content:
Hello, gamers!

We are going to host our second developer livestream during the Steam Next Fest. Join us to watch and discuss our game, and play our demo.

[b]ABOUT THIS GAME[/b]

Tinting Time is a Japanese-style crafting game. Play as a creator who can create all kinds of solutions, and spend some leisure time in the city of Folest. The game's creation system that combines crafting and complex resource management gameplay is eye-catching.

notes.title: Future plans for Tinting Time
notes.content:
The translation of the Tinting Time is almost complete. But I have some news for you.

The current game content of Tinting Time is complete, but it is not eye-catching. So I want to expand the game content before the game is released. The main content of the expansion is the game mode. This means that the game will include two different game modes: Story Mode and Rouge-Lite Mode after release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786759/824c2a3a741b7b46c07c6e10a834e134eb14161c.png[/img]

But it will take more time to expand the game mode. At present, I have not given a specific release time for the game, and it is expected that the game will be released in the middle of 2022.

The good news is that before the game is released, I will be releasing a free trial version to help you better understand what Tinting Time really is.

notes.title: About Tinting Time
notes.content:
Tinting time is on its the final localization translation work and will be able to see you soon.

So far, the game has been developed by myself alone for a year, and the main content of the game has been completed. Final translation and pre-release debugging are currently underway. Tinting Time contains an enormous amount of text that takes some time to translate. Therefore, the game will be released in both Chinese and English languages.

I'm really looking forward to let you play the game as soon as possible. If there are no surprises, the game will soon be able to confirm the specific release time.

Although I'm not a professional artist, I thought that sharing some crude original art would help you get a little understanding of this upcoming game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786759/fef71f911f46772c4dd79bd3ef9592a3465881ac.jpg[/img]

The Takaku's share house is the main stage of the game, where our protagonist will "create" things. The room is filled with laughter every day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786759/0dd3cdb25eefb79b840f3bc72bcc2f51faa21cee.jpg[/img]

Takaku is the protagonist of the game's first script. She is "flutter" in both appearance and thought. In Avril's words, "Her head is full of marshmallows!"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786759/129f95b4c6f55a6600997f30a94774a24ef9ed23.jpg[/img]

Avril is much more reliable. For a while, I even wanted to use a short hair design to further reflect her capable personality.

If you want to discuss more about this game, you can join the qq group 548011771, or email TintingTime@163.com
to communicate with me.
